_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Spark's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right), the standing idle (poses.stand: ../side_idle/idle_v1.png, 1024x765 on a white background) and the ready pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png, 1024x765, kneeling, hugging the gun). Source px unless noted. height: the run frames at Rookie's source px per world px (the heads drawn the same size: 62.26 = 60 x his figure 552 / Rookie's 532 source px; the spiky hair makes him a little taller); idle: the standing picture (poses.stand); walk 15 fps: the planted foot moves back ~6 world px a frame (Rookie ~4.7 at 20 fps), 90 px/s walk. See assets/README.md.

idle._doc: the standing picture (poses.stand); without it the run frame 0 (frame_1.png)

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

stand._doc: pose px (1024x765): standing upright, facing right, on a WHITE background (keyed out: `background` key white, only the white reached from the picture's border through near-white pixels, the dark outline the wall; holeMin so big no enclosed white goes: the highlights inside the figure stay; a white key has no spill: nothing despilled; then cleaned like the run frames: alphaCut / keepPieces / defringe). scale: source px per pose px (0.97: the hair and the face 4 % wider than in the run frames, the figure about as tall: the head does not drop idle <-> walk; the ready pose uses the same scale and alignX, its head drawn the same: no jump idle <-> ready); alignX: the ear on frame_1's; the soles on the soles' row.

ready._doc: pose px (1024x765): kneeling, facing right, both gloved fists together on the chest, NO gun, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`, holeMin / holePure / spillFrom keyed as Flora's; the AI sparkle bottom right goes with the detached pieces, keepPieces). scale / alignX: the standing idle's (the same picture size, the head drawn the same: it does not jump on the switch). The hug gun is placed in `scene` (its GunSocket on the fists: the gun turns round it).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the hug point, the middle of the two fists (pose px), level

armFront._doc: the near arm drawn OVER the hugged gun (assets/characters/spark/side/ready_arm_front.png, same canvas as ready_0), pose px: polygon round the bare near shoulder and upper arm, the elbow and the forearm, the green fingerless glove and both fists; seeds: one point inside each piece the outline walls in (the far shoulder and forearm right of the fists stay under the gun). See Rookie's config for the keys.
